newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks rebound on short covering, end up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks rebound on short covering, end up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday amid covering of short positions after the index slipped in early trade, dealers said.
They said selective blue-chip buying by institutions prompted speculators to cover their short positions.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 10.29 points, or 0.67 percent, to close at 1,540.40 at 0903 GMT. The index had dropped to 1,524.99 in early trade.
Losers led gainers 162 to 75. ICI Pakistan rose 0.80 to 24.15 rupees and Lever Brothers 15 to 715.
